description: This Java class represents the response to a 'ModifyPolicy' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles creating, parsing, and managing responses related to policy modification operations, including serialization/deserialization to/from JSON, and provides utility methods for response creation based on different HTTP status outcomes.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response to a 'ModifyPolicy' command, encapsulating policy modification details and providing JSON serialization/deserialization support.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a newly created policy, with deprecated overload accepting a string policy ID.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a modified policy, with overload accepting a PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a response object from a JSON string or JSON object, along with headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicyCreated
methods.description: Returns the created Policy if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the created Policy as a JsonValue, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer representing the resource path, which is empty for this response.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the response data to a JsonObjectBuilder, respecting the schema and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with the provided DittoHeaders.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of this class for equality purposes.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines whether this response is equal to another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for this response.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this response object.
